title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to execute code in protected pipelines via a scheduled pipeline execution policy after the policy was unassigned due to improper authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
